headline: Saga Tekkohsho Co., Ltd. Confirms Ransomware Attack
body: Saga Tekkohsho Co., Ltd., a key player in the automotive manufacturing sector, has confirmed a ransomware attack that compromised its internal systems. The incident, which occurred in 2024, involved the theft of approximately a terabyte of sensitive data, including quality-control records and client folders. The company is actively investigating the breach with the assistance of external cybersecurity experts. Saga Tekkohsho Co., Ltd. has also notified relevant authorities as part of its response strategy.
